verdict.rationale: Browserbase has a reference section in its docs, including a Node.js SDK reference, and offers 30+ ready-made templates. Nothing in the pack shows an interactive, try-it API explorer, and every probed OpenAPI/Swagger spec path returned 404, so only static reference material and starter code are evidenced. Missing for 10: an interactive API playground, runnable in-docs request examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
